description: Pinned native runtime components of the BirkNext Windows Tester Package (TesterNative profile). Every input is an exact version from an official upstream source with a SHA-256 recorded here; the package build refuses any other bytes and never fetches 'latest'. Changing a version means changing this file in a reviewed commit.

postgresql.compatibleWith: postgres:16 developer container (16.13 at the time of pinning)
postgresql.source: EnterpriseDB Windows x64 binaries, the distribution linked from postgresql.org/download/windows
postgresql.checksumProvenance: EnterpriseDB publishes no checksum for this archive: the value is the SHA-256 of the archive downloaded over HTTPS from the official URL on 2026-11-11 (trust on first use). The binaries carry no Authenticode signature.
windowsPrerequisites: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64): vcruntime140.dll and msvcp140.dll are imported by the PostgreSQL binaries and not part of the archive

k6.checksumProvenance: Matches the upstream k6-v1.0.0-checksums.txt published with the release.

dotnet.note: The backend and the launcher are published self-contained for win-x64 with the .NET 8 runtime of the SDK that builds the package (recorded in config/runtime-manifest.json).
